system.longDesc:
Cost: 1 SP

Some investigation stunts have different effects depending on whether you are pursuing a simple or detailed investigation, denoted by parenthetical tags.

This test reminds you of something important you forgot. The GM reveals the identity or existence of another source of information you didn’t know about (Simple); treat one of your tangential focuses as a primary one on the next test you make to unlock a lead related to this test (Detailed).
